design.density: Comfortable workspace with compact data tables

must: Preserve legal copy, issue rules and project storage
Support keyboard focus and reduced motion

decisions: Translate Nusa Bay dashboard structure into a restrained legal workspace
Keep the original neutral grey-and-white palette as the default theme
Offer navy blue and dark green as complete light workspace palettes through shared semantic tokens and persistent native radio controls
Retain red, amber and green legal-review signals across app themes
Use a consistent open-page header baseline across Deal Map, Deal Hub, Action Library and Settings
Use 21st sidebar, card-tabs and theme-switch patterns as inspiration, without importing React dependencies
Company Radar role selection follows the Deal Map pill selector: an initial prompt expands to role options, then collapses to the chosen role
